limitations.accessIsolation: Access isolation is procedural evidence, not cryptographic isolation, because judgment contexts share a filesystem.
limitations.classification: Learner-facing surface classification remains a reviewer judgment; deterministic extraction cannot certify omitted or misclassified surfaces.
limitations.inventoryCompleteness: Inventory completeness remains a reviewer judgment; deterministic verification covers only the explicitly declared inventory.
limitations.reviewAdjudicationSubstance: Review and adjudication substance remains a reviewer/adjudicator judgment; deterministic verification checks structural completeness, binding, and verdict consistency, not technical, pedagogical, accessibility, or language correctness.
limitations.roleRequirementAdequacy: Role-requirement adequacy remains a reviewer judgment; deterministic verification checks only the frozen requirement's exact binding and coverage.

report.inventoryLimitation: This evidence covers only the explicitly declared inventory. Completeness and classification of learner-facing surfaces remain reviewer-judged; the tool does not discover or certify omitted surfaces.
